Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,409,803 million (¥1,238,859 million in the previous year), the largest of the four reportable segments and more than half of consolidated revenue of ¥2,267,577 million. Its major affiliates are the Henley group, Metricon group and Scott Park group in Australia, and the Bloomfield Homes, Crescent Communities, DRB, Edge Homes, FLT, MainVue Homes and Mark III Properties, LLC, and JPI groups in the United States. entries.1d47424dbeccf324: This is the field of managing overseas tree plantations and similar operations. In the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales of wood fuel used in biomass power generation increased in volume, but the number of newly built housing starts in Japan fell, so sales of wood and building materials remained difficult and performance stalled. In August 2025, the company signed a capital and business alliance agreement with GeoLive Group Co., Ltd., which operates building materials distribution, and is aiming to build a unique supply chain combining the functions and know-how of both companies.
entries.e3828379650a5d51: This was one of the acquisitions expanding the detached housing business in the United States.
entries.e6e99d0a7449ed5f: This was the year the company name "Sumitomo Forestry" began to be used. From forest management and the collection and sale of domestic timber, the company expanded the products it handled to the import of foreign timber and the handling of building materials. Revenue from external customers of the Timber & Building Materials Business in the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥232,043 million, the third largest among the 4 reporting segments.
entries.eaa17d32c21bd257: In January 2016, the company acquired an interest in the DRB Group of the United States and made it a consolidated subsidiary.
entries.eb8438d797d6dd45: Domestic Medium- and Large-Scale Wooden Construction Business
entries.ebc509feca54e30d: In October 1984, the company established Nelson Pine Industries Ltd. (a consolidated subsidiary) in New Zealand and began the manufacture and sale of MDF (medium density fiberboard).
entries.ef6ff13ec5db0793: In the United States and Australia it sells houses for sale and undertakes construction work for detached houses, and in Japan it handles detached custom-built houses, rental houses and renovation. In addition to purchasing, manufacturing, processing and selling timber and building materials, it also conducts woody biomass power generation and manages plantation land overseas.
entries.ef9642efc5a95c31: The JPI Group (SFA JPI Top Holdings, LLC and 159 other companies) is listed as a main affiliate of the current Construction & Real Estate Business. As of December 31, 2025, the ownership ratio of voting rights in SFA JPI Top Holdings, LLC is 90.1%.
entries.ef98d7a6378a8c4c: In April 2014, the company acquired an interest in the Gehan Homes Group of the United States (the Brightland Homes Group after the name change) and made it a consolidated subsidiary.
entries.f04bf7e2821b27db: Its customers are customers who build or buy houses, owners of "Sumitomo Forestry homes," and sales destinations for timber and building materials and woody fuel for biomass power generation. Dividing consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 by customer location gives ¥830,936 million in Japan, ¥1,041,639 million in the United States, ¥350,142 million in Australia and ¥44,860 million in other regions. No specific customer accounts for 10% or more of net sales.
entries.f1605943b0af4665: This field builds detached houses in Australia.
entries.f5862fc979de8607: Its customers are customers who build or buy houses, owners of "Sumitomo Forestry homes," and sales destinations for timber and building materials and woody fuel for biomass power generation.
entries.f6a3f75823c1a710: Construction Contracting for Detached and Multi-Unit Housing
entries.f87d4cc90924b990: It is a housing company centered on timber that handles the construction and sale of houses overseas, custom-built houses in Japan, the distribution of timber and building materials, and forest management.
entries.fc60fa8c1de53a1f: The company changed the trade name of Sumirin Maintenance Co., Ltd., which it had established in October 1988, to Sumitomo Forestry Home Tech Co., Ltd. (a consolidated subsidiary) in April 1991 and fully entered the renovation business.
